changelog: **Mail delivery: transactional and bulk mail paced through the queue (#2951):** `MAIL_QUEUE_LANES=TRANSACTIONAL,BULK` puts those lanes straight on the mail queue, and with `MAIL_METER_MODE=enforce` the drain spends one budget token per row. The drain now claims in bands: the higher lanes first (a batch at a time), then ONE bulk row per round, alternating `payload.world` between INTERNSHIP and MARKETING with a fallback to any (`claim({ filter })` in `src/lib/jobs/queue.ts` — a priority band and one payload field, with an in-memory twin). Every queued row carries its world. The optional `MAIL_DAILY_CAP` (and `MAIL_BULK_DAILY_CAP`) counts every metered send per environment per UTC day on `MailBudget.dayKey/dayCount`, in the same conditional UPDATE as the token, and stops BULK at 90 %; a capped row waits for the next UTC day. Natural de-duplication keys and `notAfter` are added for meeting, series and guest reminders (key includes the start time, deadline = the start), digests, weekly report reminders, surveys and operator alerts (`ops:<kind>:<window>`). The e-mail health alert is queued under a six-hour key instead of a per-process timestamp. The unread digest stamps `digestedAt` only for recipients whose digest was SENT, QUEUED or refused for good (a 5xx; plus muted lines), with a 7-day lookback. `NewsletterSend` gains `QUEUED` (additive `EmailStatus` value), settled to SENT/FAILED/SKIPPED by `settleMailRef()` (`src/lib/mailRefHooks.ts`) when the queued mail settles. The newsletter, announcement (`src/lib/announcementMail.ts`) and bulk invitation fan-outs run one recipient at a time when their lane is queued and four at a time otherwise (`fanOutWidth()`), bulk invitations and bulk resends ride the TRANSACTIONAL lane when that lane is queued (`bulkInvitationLane()`), a paced lane's mail too large for the queue waits for its token inline under enforce (at most 2 min), and each of the three tells the admin how many mails were queued and roughly how long delivery takes (the caller's organization's queue only, at the lane's effective rate). The deploy scripts pass `MAIL_DAILY_CAP`, and `.env.example` lists the recommended values per environment.

en: Large sends such as announcements, newsletters and bulk invitations are now paced instead of tripping the mail server. The confirmation tells you how many emails are queued and roughly how long delivery will take.
tr: Duyurular, bültenler ve toplu davetler gibi büyük gönderimler artık posta sunucusunu zorlamak yerine aralıklarla gönderiliyor. Onay mesajı kaç e-postanın kuyrukta olduğunu ve teslimatın yaklaşık ne kadar süreceğini gösteriyor.
de: Große Sendungen wie Ankündigungen, Newsletter und Sammeleinladungen werden jetzt verteilt zugestellt, statt den Mailserver zu überlasten. Die Bestätigung zeigt, wie viele E-Mails in der Warteschlange sind und wie lange die Zustellung ungefähr dauert.
